sentences.en: My little brother ran through the living room stark naked.
sentences.zh: 我的小弟弟光着身子跑过了客厅。

sentences.en: Layla had to make a stark choice: left or right.
sentences.zh: 莱拉不得不做出一个艰难的选择：左还是右。

sentences.en: She went stark raving mad after learning of her brother's suicide.
sentences.zh: 得知哥哥自杀的消息后，她疯了似的。
